about: known_failures: test name -> library bug that makes it fail. These failures do not fail the run; remove an entry once its bug is fixed.
skip_modes: run_tests.bat mode -> why the campaign is not run in that mode (it exits 0).

mednafen_args: extra mednafen settings for the campaign (timer_pal starts mednafen as a European, PAL console). mednafen saves them in its config: campaigns without mednafen_args pass -ss.region_autodetect 1 instead.

known_failures.fxp_round: for negative values with a fraction of 1/2 or more, Round returns Floor(value - 1/2): one too low when the fraction is above a half (Round(-2.7) = -4), and next to the minimum value - 1/2 overflows int32 (Round(-32767.9999) = 32767); Floor(value) gives the right result; fixed on SaturnMathPP branch fix/round-negative-values (2656a7a); remove after bumping the submodule
known_failures.fxp_division_negative_non_integer: Hardware::ArithmeticShiftRight<N> (N > 2) negates, shifts logically and negates back, which rounds toward zero instead of down: the high word of the 64-bit dividend of a negative non-integer is one too high (-1.5 / 2 = -0.25, -0.985 / 0.174 = +0.0863)
known_failures.fxp_as_int_runtime_matches_compile_time: As<int32_t>() rounds down at compile time (value >> 16) but toward zero at run time (Hardware::ArithmeticShiftRight<16>, see fxp_division_negative_non_integer): -1.5 gives -1 instead of -2, -0.25 gives 0 instead of -1
known_failures.fxp_shift_operators: >> rounds down at compile time but toward zero at run time (Hardware::ArithmeticShiftRight, see fxp_division_negative_non_integer): raw -3 >> 1 gives -1 instead of -2; its comment also calls it a logical shift
known_failures.vector2d_lengthsquared_sum_overflow: LengthSquared only checks each component against MaxSafeSquareValue (about 181.02), not the sum: (130,130) gives 33800, which wraps to about -31736 instead of the documented MaxValue (Vector3D guards each component against sqrt(32768 / 3), which covers its sum); fixed on SaturnMathPP branch fix/vector-overflow-and-compound (d82b7e4); remove after bumping the submodule
known_failures.fxp_convert_from_more_fraction_bits: converting a negative 8.24 value to 16.16 rounds down at compile time but toward zero at run time (Hardware::ArithmeticShiftRight, see fxp_division_negative_non_integer): raw -1 gives 0 instead of -1, raw -0x1FF gives -1 instead of -2
known_failures.vector2d_reflect: Reflect divides -2(v.n) by |n|^2 with Fxp division, which is wrong at run time for a negative non-whole dividend (see fxp_division_negative_non_integer): Reflect((0,0.375), (0,2)) gives (0,0.125) instead of (0,-0.375)
known_failures.vector2d_project_onto: ProjectOnto divides v.t by |t|^2 with Fxp division, which is wrong at run time for a negative non-whole dividend (see fxp_division_negative_non_integer): ProjectOnto((-1.5,2), (1,0)) gives (-0.5,0) instead of (-1.5,0)
known_failures.fxp_arithmetic_shift_right_all_branches: Hardware::ArithmeticShiftRight rounds toward zero for negative values in the runtime overload and the template for shifts above 2 (-3 >> 1 = -1, -1 >> 4 = 0); the template shar branches (shifts 1 and 2) are right; fixed on SaturnMathPP branch fix/arithmetic-shift-right-rounding (8a3c1f1); remove after bumping the submodule
known_failures.fxp_parallel_division_negative_non_integ: ParallelDiv builds its 64-bit dividend with ArithmeticShiftRight<16>, like operator/: -1.5 / 2 gives -0.25; fixed on SaturnMathPP branch fix/arithmetic-shift-right-rounding (8a3c1f1); remove after bumping the submodule
known_failures.fxp_shift_assign_negative: >>= rounds toward zero at run time (ArithmeticShiftRight): raw -3 >>= 1 gives -1, raw -1 >>= 4 gives 0; fixed on SaturnMathPP branch fix/arithmetic-shift-right-rounding (8a3c1f1); remove after bumping the submodule
known_failures.random_get_number_branches: GetNumber(from, to) maps from + number % range with a signed range, so a raw number already in range is not returned unchanged (GetNumber(n / 2, n) returns n - 1), and an int8_t seed of 0 stays 0; fixed on SaturnMathPP branch fix/random-ranges-and-state (18bc258); remove after bumping the submodule
known_failures.vector2d_lengthsquared_runtime_boundary: LengthSquared of (128,128) is 32768, which does not fit, but Vector2D only guards each component, so the sum wraps instead of giving MaxValue (at compile time and at run time alike); fixed on SaturnMathPP branch fix/vector-overflow-and-compound (d82b7e4); remove after bumping the submodule
known_failures.fxp_add_sub_runtime_matches_compile_time: runtime MaxValue + 1 wraps (signed int32 overflow, undefined behavior), compile time saturates; += and -= never saturate, so a + b and a += b disagree even at compile time
known_failures.trigonometry_tan_matches_sin_over_cos: -80 to -10: Tan is right, the Sin/Cos reference is wrong because runtime Fxp division of a negative non-integer is wrong (see fxp_division_negative_non_integer); 60 to 80: the first Tan table interpolates linearly over 5.625 degree steps and overshoots near 90 (+0.8% at 60, +2.1% at 70, +8.7% at 80); Tan(x+180) differs from Tan(x) by up to 0.005 for negative x (not investigated)
known_failures.trigonometry_slerp: Angle::SLerp(10, 350, 0.5) goes the long way round (180 instead of 0): it scales other - this with Angle::operator*(Fxp), whose ToFxp() reads the raw angle as unsigned (340 degrees stays +0.944 turns instead of -20 degrees); reading the difference as int16_t (-180 to +180) before scaling takes the shortest path
known_failures.vector3d_arithmetic_operators: Vector3D operator+= and operator-= return Vector3 by value, though documented as returning a reference (Vector2D returns Vector2&): (c += b) += b adds b once, the second += changes a temporary copy; -= has the same bug, its check is not reached because the test stops at the first failure; fixed on SaturnMathPP branch fix/vector-overflow-and-compound (d82b7e4); remove after bumping the submodule
known_failures.mat33_scale_in_place_documented: Scale does not match its documentation: the code scales each column (every .X by sx, .Y by sy, .Z by sz, so M * S), the comment shows each row scaled (S * M); they agree only on Identity, so SaturnMathPP has to pick its row/column convention (see transform_set_matrix_matches_matrix43)
known_failures.random_seed_zero_not_stuck: seed 0 only gives zeros: Random is an xorshift generator and the constructor keeps a 0 seed, which xorshift never leaves (replace a 0 seed with a non-zero constant); fixed on SaturnMathPP branch fix/random-ranges-and-state (18bc258); remove after bumping the submodule
known_failures.random_variety_per_type: 8-bit GetNumber() gives a single value (u8 and i8: 1 distinct value): types of 16 bits or fewer use the 16-bit shifts 7, 9, 8, and in an 8-bit state >> 9 is always 0 and << 8 drops out, so the state cycles through one or two values (keep a uint32_t state and return it cast to T); fixed on SaturnMathPP branch fix/random-ranges-and-state (18bc258); remove after bumping the submodule
known_failures.random_dice_distribution: u8 GetNumber(1, 6) always returns 1: the 8-bit generator barely moves (see random_variety_per_type); fixed on SaturnMathPP branch fix/random-ranges-and-state (18bc258); remove after bumping the submodule
known_failures.random_signed_wide_range: int16 GetNumber(-30000, 30000) stays in [-29999, -24497]: GetNumber(from, to) computes range = to - from + 1 in T, and 60001 wraps to -5535 in int16_t, so from + (|number| % -5535) never leaves -30000 to -24466 (compute the range in the unsigned type); fixed on SaturnMathPP branch fix/random-ranges-and-state (18bc258); remove after bumping the submodule
known_failures.random_range_int8_minus1_matches_raw: GetNumber(min + 1, max - 1) returned min + 1, not the expected value: GetNumber(from, to) computes range = to - from + 1 in T, and 2^n - 2 wraps to -2 in a signed type, so the result is stuck at min + 1 or min + 2 (compute the range in the unsigned type); fixed on SaturnMathPP branch fix/random-ranges-and-state (18bc258); remove after bumping the submodule
known_failures.random_range_int16_minus1_matches_raw: GetNumber(min + 1, max - 1) returned min + 1, not the expected value: GetNumber(from, to) computes range = to - from + 1 in T, and 2^n - 2 wraps to -2 in a signed type, so the result is stuck at min + 1 or min + 2 (compute the range in the unsigned type); fixed on SaturnMathPP branch fix/random-ranges-and-state (18bc258); remove after bumping the submodule
known_failures.random_range_int32_minus1_matches_raw: GetNumber(min + 1, max - 1) returned min + 1, not the expected value: GetNumber(from, to) computes range = to - from + 1 in T, and 2^n - 2 wraps to -2 in a signed type, so the result is stuck at min + 1 or min + 2 (compute the range in the unsigned type); fixed on SaturnMathPP branch fix/random-ranges-and-state (18bc258); remove after bumping the submodule
known_failures.utils_fast_sqrt_values: FastSqrt(10000^2) = 11243: the loop stops when baseEstimation >= estimation, so the two can differ 4x and their sum is up to 25% above the root (+25% near 2^30); stopping one step earlier, while (baseEstimation < (estimation >> 1)), keeps them within 2x like Fxp::Sqrt, at most +6.1%
known_failures.interpolation_elastic_ease_in: Fxp::ElasticEaseIn(0, 1, 0.99) = 2.0: it is not elastic but one parabola, Lerp(start, end, 2t(2 - t)), rising to twice the range (1.5 at t = 0.5) and jumping back to end at t = 1; a real elastic ease-in (-2^(10(t-1)) * sin((t - 1.075) * 2pi / 0.3)) gives about 0.91 at t = 0.99 and ends smoothly at 1

known_failures.vdp2_vram_access_cycles: bankCycles starts at -1 for A0-B0 but at 2 for B1, so B1 gives 5 cycles, not 6
known_failures.vdp2_load_tilemap_then_clear: ClearVRAM frees NBG0-NBG3 palettes with RBG0's color mode, so a 16-color bank stays used

known_failures.cdda_resume_after_pause: Resume does not stop at the end of the paused track and plays on into track 3: it looks the next track up as Tracks[TargetTrack + 1] (that is track TargetTrack + 2), in a table whose entries are 8 bytes instead of 4 (see cd_test_tray_and_table_details), so it plays to the end of the disc
known_failures.cinepak_load_twice: LoadMovie does not unload the movie already loaded: its file stays open, so with one GFS file at a time the second LoadMovie cannot open the movie

known_failures.transform_set_matrix_matches_matrix43: SGL reads a Matrix43 row as a column: Matrix43::TransformPoint uses Row0-Row2 as rows, SGL (and Matrix43::CreateRotation*) as columns, so they turn points opposite ways (SaturnMathPP)

known_failures.tilemap_bmp2tile_refuses_partial_tiles: the size check masks 16x16 characters with 0x7 instead of 0xf (byte width and height), so 24-pixel 256-color bitmaps are converted with drifting rows
known_failures.tilemap_bmp2tile_refused_no_leak: a refused bitmap sets cellData, mapData and palData to NULL without deleting them (3 blocks leak)
known_failures.tilemap_load_into_nbg1_2word: Map2VRAM puts the palette at bit 20 of 2-word map data: right for 256 colors, but 16-color palettes belong at bit 16
